name: @troko/electron
description: Frameless always-on-top Dynamic Island Electron wrapper for Troko-Desk

scripts.build: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.renameSync('dist/preload.js', 'dist/preload.cjs'))"
